entries.c261b06bc8cf75d4: This is the business that forms the foundation of the Group. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥95,173 million. It operates railways connecting Osaka, Kyoto and Shiga and buses centered on the areas along those lines. In October 2025, it revised passenger fares on the Keihan Line and the Otsu Line.

entries.ef66da27e4f70428: This is the Group's largest business. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥131,121 million. In addition to real estate sales and leasing, it engages in wholesale of building materials and surveying and design, among other activities. It engages in the sale of business sites in Keihanna Science City, the sale of condominiums, and the operation of rental office buildings and rental apartments, among other activities.
entries.fd9001795dab25ee: Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,090 million. The business operates the composite commercial facility "GOOD NATURE STATION", which offers sustainable experiences, and a credit card business, among others.
